description_en: Queries the number of events in the Event Center by event category
description_zh: 按事件分类查询事件中心的事件数量
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-history-events-stat --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --archive-status All --from-start-time 2025-01-02T11:31:03Z --to-start-time 2025-01-03T12:31:03Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHistoryEventsStat

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the events are located
parameters.help_zh: 事件所在地域的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The archive status of the events. Valid values:
Archived: The events are archived.
UnArchived: The events are not archived.
All: All events
parameters.help_zh: 事件归档状态。Archived 表示已归档，UnArchived 表示未归档，All 表示全部
parameters.name: archive_status

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range for task start times to query, in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务开始时间范围的起始时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC）
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the time range for task start times to query, in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务开始时间范围的结束时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC）
parameters.name: to_start_time

Items.description_en: The statistical results summarized by event category
Items.description_zh: 按事件分类汇总的统计结果

EventCategory.description_en: The system event category. For example, Exception indicates an exception event
EventCategory.description_zh: 系统事件分类，例如 Exception 表示异常事件

TotalCount.description_en: The number of events in the event category
TotalCount.description_zh: 该事件分类下的事件数量
